g.text: Positive is faster. Mixed signs and a1.30s worst regression: do not enable by default.
E56:270 main rows. E57:180 actual CLI tasks,2 warmup+7 evaluation blocks, all negative pairs retained.
Optional per-task PCH: explicit recipe only, no shared/persistent cache, new grants or disabled validation.
PCH payload14.56-15.51MB is temporary logical file size; process RSS and model/KV memory were not measured.
Interrupted warmups remain separate; final dual-clock gap <0.029ms. No system power or agent timeout change.
Remaining execution/scheduling tails are not fully attributed. Ranges are not p95/p99 or stability guarantees.
No inference code changed; E55 Native acceptance is referenced by source identity, not rerun or relabeled.
